root: ^Diary: It appears to be a weathered diary, its pages fragile from age, yet the handwriting remains intact. The name Erina Pendleton is carefully carved into the cover, likely the owner’s mark. The writing seems to be written to a loved one. A diary is a book in which one keeps a daily record of events and experiences. This one appears to have been written during the war.

^The bombs are getting closer, and I don’t know how much longer I have. But even as everything crumbles around me, I can’t stop thinking about you, Jonathan. I never imagined it would end like this, and I wish I could be with you–maybe to see the end of it all together. I can’t help but wonder what you’re doing right now, if you’re safe… if you’re thinking of me too.
